name: PK Dental Clinic - คลีนิคทันตกรรม พีเค

summary_en: Located in Bangkok, PK Dental Clinic provides general dental services to patients. The clinic holds a 4.4-star rating based on 4 total reviews and maintains a trust score of 51.2.
